newsitem.title: USA: Kerr Group stake of 5.703 held by firm.
newsitem.headline: Kerr Group stake of 5.703 held by firm.

text.p: Wynnefield Partners Small Cap Value L.P. said Monday it had acquired a 5.703 percent stake or 224,300 common shares in Kerr Group Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the New York-based investment partnership said it bought the stake for $958,494 and holds it for investment.
The partnership said it will monitor and evaluate Kerr's proposed restructuring and recapitalization plans.
Kerr, based in Lancaster, Pa., is a major producer of plastic packaging products.
